description.en: OpenCode Go console usage windows and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 OpenCode Go 控制台用量窗口与模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and optional console details for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台信息。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the auth cookie from opencode.ai to refresh 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 opencode.ai 粘贴 auth Cookie，用于刷新 5 小时、每周与每月用量。

help_text.en: Optional. Set the workspace explicitly if automatic discovery selects the wrong one.
help_text.zh: 可选。自动发现选择了错误工作区时，填写目标 Workspace ID。
